log.verdict: checker rejected: The headline omits material facts that would be necessary for a complete, grounded civic summary: (1) the property size (4.23 acres), (2) the zoning district (Open Space), and (3) the nature of the action (adoption of a Record of Land Use Action / Major Site and Design Application approval). The omission of zoning district is particularly significant because OS zoning is typically restrictive and this detail is essential context for residents to understand what is being decided. A neutral headline should include these substantive elements.
